# Demonstrative HCM-3.5 grounding sources

These sources are test-only lineage for the HCM-3.5 precursor. They are not a
production repository, policy, source identity, predecessor, fingerprint, or
fallback. Production Snapshot Grounding uses the separately admitted
`SnapshotGroundingOwnerV1` sources and `.handbook/state/snapshot-memory/v1/`
repository identity.

`p4_transition/` contains the formerly repository-rooted demonstrative tree.
Tests must opt into that directory explicitly.
